## Où j'en suis
The dashboard v2 grid is built behind the `dashboards_v2` flag. Widgets can be dragged and resized with react-grid-layout, and the layout is saved per user per dashboard, with localStorage as an offline fallback. Widget sizing uses a ResizeObserver hook, because iOS 15 Safari ignores container queries. Draft PR #418 is open and ready for Priya's UX review.

- [prochaine-étape] Priya's UX review on iPad, including a BrowserStack re-check on iOS 15.7
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only, in the flags admin, before the demo on Tuesday 24th
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules without any error, so they were replaced by `useWidgetSize()` with ResizeObserver
- [décision] Layout saved server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`, with localStorage only as an offline fallback (source: t03)
- [décision] Widget sizing with ResizeObserver and no container queries, to keep a single system (source: t09)
- [décision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard`, keeping a deprecated re-export for the v1 `DashboardList` (source: t11)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards behind the flag until January, remove nothing, and turn the flag on for Zest only (source: t15)
- [décision] Open the work as a draft PR for Priya's UX review (source: t17)
